title: Second-filtration spectral data with the total cohomology image filtration
statement: Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be an additive left exact functor between Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-left-exact-additive, def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Let K be a bounded-below cochain complex in $\mathcal A$, and let $a:K\to I$ be a bicomplex augmentation into a double complex with complex degree $s\in\mathbf Z$ and resolution degree $r\in\mathbf N$. Assume that I vanishes for $s<b$ for some integer b, every $I^{s,r}$ is injective and every row augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Set $T=\operatorname{Tot}((F(I)\text{ extended by zero})^{\mathrm{flip}})$ using [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. There exist a filtration L of T by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration], a cohomological spectral sequence E starting at page zero, page-zero identifications with the degreewise graded pieces, and signed identifications $E_1^{s,r}\cong R^rF(K^s)$. The steps of L equal the second-filtration image sums [def-sp-double-complex-total]. The page-zero differential is that of the graded complex; the terms at every page $t\ge1$ are the cokernels of the inclusions $B_t\subseteq Z_t$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Under the signed first-page identifications, $d_1$ is $R^rF(d_K)$, and $E_1^{p,q}=0$ for $q<0$. For every family of objects $Y^n$ and isomorphisms $c_n:H^n(T)\cong Y^n$, there is a finite decreasing filtration H on each $Y^n$ whose p-th step is the direct image along $c_n$ of $\operatorname{im}(H^n(L^pT)\to H^n(T))$. For each p,n there is $t\ge1$ such that all page-r terms at $(p,n-p)$ for $r\ge t$ are isomorphic to $\operatorname{gr}^pH(Y^n)$. This statement asserts no derived-complex interpretation of $H^n(T)$.

proof.text: Choose the lower bound b. Extend by zero, flip and apply F. Mathlib zero preservation and extension-by-zero vanishing give the half-plane support. Apply lem-sp-bounded-below-second-filtration to obtain L, the step formula, and degreewise top/bottom bounds.

Apply lem-sp-cartan-eilenberg-row-pages to this L and the augmented injective rows. It supplies E, page-zero comparisons, all page quotients, signed right-derived comparisons with unsigned d1, and negative-degree vanishing.

The bounds b and n+1 show degreewise finiteness. Apply lem-sp-degreewise-filtered-stable-quotient to L and c. For each p,n choose its stabilization threshold. At every later page, rewrite p+(n-p)=n in the page-quotient comparison and compose it with the stable-quotient comparison. Proof irrelevance identifies the two witnesses of the boundary inclusion.
